Drag to move. Corner resizing keeps proportions. Hold a piece for its menu.

Two fingers move and rotate a piece. Pinch horizontally to stretch width, vertically for height, or diagonally to scale both. On empty canvas they pan and zoom the view. Rotation snaps to 5°.
